mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON I.MEMBER_CODE = M.MEMBER_CODE LEFT JOIN CREATOR CR ON I.OPERATOR_CODE = CR.OPERATOR_CODE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN ANSWER IS NULL OR TRIM(ANSWER) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WAITING_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN ANSWER IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ANSWER) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COMPLETED_COUNT FROM INQUIRY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQUIRY I JOIN INQUIRY_TYPE IT ON I.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE = IT.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE
WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( I.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' OR NVL(M.NAME, CR.ACTIVITY_NAME) LIKE '%' || #{search.keyword} || '%' )
AND I.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE = #{search.inquiryTypeCode}
AND (I.ANSWER IS NULL OR TRIM(I.ANSWER) IS NULL)
AND I.ANSWER IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(I.ANSWER) IS NOT NULL

SELECT I.INQUIRY_CODE, I.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE, IT.INQUIRY_TYPE_NAME, I.MANAGER_CODE, I.OPERATOR_CODE, I.MEMBER_CODE, CASE WHEN I.OPERATOR_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN CR.ACTIVITY_NAME ELSE M.NAME END AS WRITER_NAME, I.WRITER_TYPE, I.TITLE, I.CONTENT, I.INQUIRY_IMG, I.INQUIRY_DATE, I.ANSWER, I.ANSWER_DATE, CASE WHEN I.ANSWER IS NULL OR TRIM(I.ANSWER) IS NULL THEN '답변대기' ELSE '답변완료' END AS ANSWER_STATUS FROM INQUIRY I JOIN INQUIRY_TYPE IT ON I.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE = IT.INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE
WHERE I.INQUIRY_CODE = #{inquiryCode}
SELECT INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE, INQUIRY_TYPE_NAME FROM INQUIRY_TYPE ORDER BY INQUIRY_TYPE_CODE
